name: Langry RH550-A Heavy-Duty High-Strength Hammer
short_description: Maximum impact energy (5.400 J) hammer for mass concrete installations, dams, tunnel linings, and ultra-high-strength concrete (UHPC) up to 120 MPa.
description: The **Langry RH550-A Heavy-Duty Concrete Test Hammer** delivers the highest nominal impact energy in the Langry series at 5.400 Joules. It is engineered for ultra-high-strength concrete (UHPC), hydraulic dam spillways, nuclear containment vessels, and massive foundation rafts reaching compressive strengths up to 120 MPa.

key_features.feature: Maximum 5.400 Joules impact energy for ultra-dense concrete
Extended measuring capacity from 60 to 120 MPa
Ultra-rugged hardened structural components for heavy field abuse
Calibrated against heavy-duty steel anvil producing 88 ± 2 index

seo_title: Langry RH550-A Heavy-Duty Rebound Hammer (120 MPa) | Accurion
seo_description: Langry RH550-A heavy-duty 5.4 J rebound hammer for mass concrete, dams, and UHPC testing up to 120 MPa. Available across India from Accurion Technologies.
